parsed.lead:
Forging is the process of powering up Bots or Modules by consuming lower-tiered Bots or Modules. This will raise the Attack, Health, and Class Power of the higher-tiered Bot. 

The higher the Tier, Rank, Level, and Signature Ability of the Bots and Mods put into the Forge, the greater the benefits they provide. Bots and Mods consumed in the Forge also payout class Ore-13 and Gold based on their aforementioned stats. Bonus items, mainly Bot Crystal Shards, can be given as well.

Bots will only be able to consume other Bots, as Mods will consume other Mods. Only 2-Star and above can be forged. 

The Class Power of your Bot and Module governs the strength of their Class Bonus. The higher your Class Power, the more your Attack increases and the more the enemy Attack decreases when you have a Class Advantage. For example, Scout Bots have Class Advantage over Tech Bots, which have a Class Advantage over Demolitions Bots, and so on.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text:
To access the Forge, select “Bots” from the main menu to open your Bot inventory. Tap on any Bot for a list of actions that may be performed on that Bot. Select “Forge” to enter the Forge screen. Switch to the “Modules” tab to access Forging for Mods. You must own a minimum of 13 Bots or 8 Modules before Forging becomes available, and those Bots must be across more than one Tier.

Only Bots whose Tier is lower than the target Bot can be Forged. For example, a 4-Star Bot accepts 1~3-Star Bots, but a 2-Star Bot only accepts 1-Star Bots. The same applies to Modules.
Bots that are the same Tier cannot be Forged. You cannot consume a 4-Star Bot in order to power-up another 4-Star Bot. The same applies to Modules.

sections.heading: Benefits
sections.text: You can unlock the maximum potential of your target Bot using the same Bot one tier below the target. This one-time only bonus will raise the max Forge Level from 75 to 100 of the target Bot permanently. The above bonuses also apply to Modules.

sections.heading: Why remove Bots from your Inventory?
sections.text:
As you progress through the game, you acquire and upgrade many different Bots. Eventually, you may acquire Bots that are so powerful that you use them everywhere and leave your other weaker Bots behind. 

The Forge ensures the effort your put into those “weaker” Bots can be carried forward into your strongest Bots. In essence, Forging ensures Bots are never obsolete, even if you stop using them, because they can still serve the purpose of enhancing those at the top of your roster. 

All forged points in a Bot will be carried over if that Bot is forged.

sections.heading: Statistics
sections.text:
* 2-Star Bots can have from 75% to 110%, then if dupe-forged 125% Class advantage boost.
* 3-5~Star Bots can have from 100% to 147~150%, then 167% Class advantage boost.

Sharkticons, when forged, give Sharkticon Crystal Shards in greater amounts instead of regular Bot Crystal Shards.
Category:Gameplay

parsed.lead:
On May 10, 2023,

Transformers: Forged to Fight was made available on the Netflix Games streaming service. There are several key differences between this version of the game and the original at time of closure, and this page will document such changes as they come.

sections.heading: Discord Announcement
sections.text:
Light our Darkest Hour!

Prepare to return to New Quintessa! 

Transformers Fans, prepare to roll out once again! Transformers: Forged to Fight is returning to mobile devices today, exclusively for Netflix members! 

Join Optimus Prime, Bumblebee Marissa Fairborne, and many of your favorite Bots for a new adventure on New Quintessa. 

This new version of Transformers: Forged to Fight revives the award-winning 3D fighting game that our Commanders knew and loved, with a re-imagined story full of new twists and adventures. The game is included with all Netflix memberships without ads or in-app purchases. 

This new version of the game also introduces two brand new bots with completely new animations and abilities, Dead End and Chromia! 

Netflix members can download the game today: https://netflix.com/game/81633034 

To answer some questions that you may have: 
Will my progress carry over? 
This is a completely new version of Transformers: Forged to Fight, and as such, no progress will be carried over, but we hope that you’ll find excitement in starting your adventure from the start once again! 

If there are no Ads or In-App Purchases, how will I obtain Energon? 
You can earn Energon by playing various modes in-game. 

How do I get Bots? 
You can earn bots by completing content, from Crystals, or by using Bot chips, which you also earn by playing! 

Will every Bot be returning?
Unfortunately, not every Bot will be making a comeback in the new game, but keep an eye out for some more old favourites coming back in the future!

sections.heading: Similarities
sections.text:
* The game seems to be based on the last version of the game before it was delisted.
* [https://forums.transformersforgedtofight.com/discussion/6270/requirements-guide This requirements guide should apply here.]

sections.heading: Differences
sections.text:
* You need an existing Netflix account to play.
* No progress is carried over.
* The biggest change yet is the removal of all Cinematic Bots due to licensing; for reference, the last Bayverse bot was released on February 8, 2018 (five years ago). Such content will be marked with the appropiate template on their respective pages. However, the Cinematic backdrops are still present. the bayverse might come back
* However, the announcement on the F2F Discord seems to suggest more "old favorites" popping in.
* As some Story elements revolve around the Bayverse Bots, such will be changed. There have been no confirmation whether Rulers of Kaon and Revenge of the King will return... yet.
* No in-app purchases for anything anymore, nor ads. You earn Energon and Bot Chips (this is now the main currency of the game) by playing the game. Think of this progression scheme as a mixture of Definitive Edition Marvel's Avengers and post-2018 Battlefront II. This means you'll be getting an excess of 500 Energon! after completing Act 1.
* Daily Crystals no longer give bots
* Most Bots are obtainable through Bot Chips.
* So are most Bot upgrade materials. Yes, you can get T3 Class and Alpha Sparks with Energon.
* A few of the Bots' Classes were changed to offset balance issues due to the Cinematic Bots being removed: Windblade is now a Warrior, Skywarp a Scout, Soundblaster a Demolitions, and Chromia a Warrior (from a Tech bot which was unreleased).

{{Header|title=Welcome to the Wiki!}} Welcome to the '''Transformers: Forged to Fight Wiki''! This wiki is a database all about [[Kabam]]'s ''[http://transformersforgedtofight.com/ Transformers: Forged to Fight]'' mobile game, featuring characters from Hasbro's ''Transformers'' franchise! '''Sadly, the game will be shutting down January 13, 2023.''' ''"During the time we have all spent together, you have put a stop to the plans of the tyrannical Megatron and his imposter, defeated the malevolent Galvatron, halted the experiments of the Quintessons, and saved this strange planet from the grips of the ancient evil, Megatronus. From every attack you’ve thrown to every base you’ve raided, you have shown this game so much support, and we appreciate every minute you have spent with us in New Quintessa. Thank you for all of your dedication. We hope this is not the last time that we will play together. You have our deepest and sincerest gratitude. Now, one final time. Commander, roll out. "'' - Kabam Miike '''I have tirelessly built this Wiki to be a comprehensive archive, but there are many stories and minor details left unchronicled. On my user page I leave a link to my virtual Forged to Fight image and file collection and fleeting legacy. If you are former Forged to Fight Commander or a newcomer who happens to check out this old defunct mobile game, thank you for stopping by! ~ [[User:Woo224|Woo224]]''' {{Header|title=Game Description}} {{Quotes| ''Calling all Autobots, Decepticons, Maximals and Predacons!'' ''Join Optimus Prime, Megatron, Bumblebee, Waspinator, Rhinox, Grimlock, Soundwave and many more of your favorite bots in the battle for supremacy where Transformers universes collide. This exciting action-fighting RPG brings the heroic storytelling and spectacular action from over 30 years of Transformers history to your mobile device!' "Features: • Collect iconic bots from the entire Transformers universe • Battle other players with devastating special attacks, ranged blasting, destructible terrain and huge 360° arenas • Team up with your friends, forge alliances and battle in global events • Set a gauntlet of bots and defenses to protect your base, get revenge on those that attack and raid enemy bases • Deploy away teams to score epic loot" "Roll Out!" }} {{Header|title=Wiki Navigation}}
